<robot name="cabinet_with_hinged_doors">

        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>

  <link name="right_door">

        <box size="0.55 0.02 1.83"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="white">
        <color rgba="0.9 0.9 0.9 1"/>
